401909095.blurb: First Knicks-Celtics meeting of the year, both coming off opening-night losses: New York dropped a 106-100 home game to Philadelphia, Boston lost 121-113 in Detroit. Boston is without Devin Carter (illness). New York's injury report is clean.

injuries.note: Illness; bench depth only.

pick.why: Both teams lost their openers, but New York is fully healthy and this is a true coin-flip matchup. Taking the points in a rivalry game that figures to be tight.

401909843.blurb: Both sides opened with wins: Atlanta put up 132 at Orlando, Charlotte won 110-103 at Brooklyn. The Hornets are thin tonight with Coby White, Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel all out, which is why the road team is laying points. Atlanta's only absences are long-term ones (Gueye, Veesaar).

injuries.note: Second-leading scorer and a starter every night; hamstring.
injuries.stats: 18.5 pts, 5.3 reb, 3.4 ast in 81 games last season

injuries.note: Starting guard and primary shot creator; calf.
Main backup big and spacing option; hamstring.
Foot fracture, out until winter.

pick.why: Charlotte is down roughly 36 points a night of scoring with Knueppel and White out, and Atlanta just put 132 on Orlando. A full-strength Hawks team should cover a short road number.

401909844.blurb: Indiana escaped New Orleans 123-120; Dallas lost 128-110 in Houston. The Mavericks are banged up in the frontcourt with Dereck Lively II (foot surgery) and Santi Aldama (knee) out and Jett Howard doubtful. Indiana is without T.J. McConnell and has Aaron Nesmith and Ben Sheppard questionable, so the 6.5 assumes a lot from the Pacers' depth.

injuries.note: Foot surgery; Dallas loses its best interior defender and lob threat.
Stretch big; knee, no timeline.
Backup point guard who runs the second unit; hamstring.
Starting wing and best perimeter defender; hamstring.
Knee.

pick.why: Indiana needed every bit of a 3-point win in New Orleans and could be without Nesmith and McConnell. Dallas is thin up front, but 6.5 asks a shorthanded Pacers team to win comfortably.

401909845.blurb: Minnesota rolled Miami 131-106 on the road to open; Orlando gave up 132 at home to Atlanta. The Magic are missing Jonathan Isaac and Anthony Black, plus Noah Penda longer term. Minnesota is without Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles) but otherwise whole. Near pick-em line.

injuries.note: Starting guard and secondary playmaker; ankle.
Orlando's best perimeter defender off the bench; knee.
Achilles surgery; long-term loss already baked into the roster.
injuries.stats: 12.2 pts, 4.1 reb, 3.8 ast in 82 games last season

pick.why: Minnesota won its opener by 25 on the road; Orlando gave up 132 at home and is without Black and Isaac on the defensive end. A near pick-em favors the healthier, hotter team.

401909846.blurb: Toronto looked like the best team in the East for one night, beating Chicago by 43. Washington opened with a 128-116 home win over Milwaukee. The Wizards list three players out, including rookie AJ Dybantsa. Toronto's rotation is healthy.

injuries.note: High-usage rookie; Washington loses a scoring option off the bench or in the starting lineup.
End of rotation.

pick.why: Toronto's rotation is whole and it just won by 43; Washington beat Milwaukee but is missing Dybantsa. The Raptors have the talent edge to win by a couple of possessions on the road.

401909847.blurb: Detroit opened by beating Boston 121-113 at home; Miami got blown out 131-106 by Minnesota at home. The Heat have a clean injury report. Detroit lists Taurean Prince as probable. Books split on this one, so it is roughly a pick-em.

injuries.note: Personal reasons; expected to play.

pick.why: Detroit beat Boston at full strength; Miami lost by 25 at home to Minnesota. With the line near pick-em, the Pistons look like the better team and get a point and a half.

401909848.blurb: Two 0-1 teams in a Friday matinee. Chicago got run off the floor 135-92 in Toronto on opening night; Milwaukee fell 128-116 at Washington. The Bulls are without Nic Claxton (hamstring, about two weeks) and list Josh Giddey and Zach Collins as probable. Milwaukee's injury report is clean.

injuries.note: Starting center and rim protector, out about two weeks with a hamstring.
Runs the offense; expected to play through a wrist sprain.
Backup big, more important with Claxton out.
injuries.stats: 9.7 pts, 5.6 reb in 10 games last season

pick.why: Milwaukee is healthy and at home against a Bulls team that lost by 43 and is missing its starting center. Laying 1.5 is nearly a straight-up pick.

401909096.blurb: Houston handled Dallas 128-110 in its opener; San Antonio lost 116-104 to Oklahoma City. The Spurs have De'Aaron Fox questionable with a wrist sprain and Tobias Harris out (calf). Houston lists Steven Adams and Reed Sheppard as questionable. Check Fox's status before tip; the line moves if he sits.

injuries.note: Starting point guard; wrist sprain. The line moves if he sits.
Starting forward; calf.
Calf tightness.
Rotation guard and shooter; knee bruise.
injuries.stats: 13.5 pts, 3.4 ast in 82 games last season

pick.why: San Antonio is laying 5.5 with Harris out and Fox questionable, against a Houston team that just won by 18. Too many points to give with that much uncertainty in the Spurs' starting five.

401909849.blurb: Both 0-1. New Orleans lost a close one to Indiana at home, 123-120; Utah lost 123-103 in Memphis. The Jazz are without Jusuf Nurkic (foot). New Orleans has no notable absences, which makes a 5.5-point line against a winless Jazz team worth a second look.

injuries.note: Starting center; foot. Utah loses rebounding and passing from the five.

pick.why: A healthy Pelicans team that lost by three to Indiana is getting 5.5 against a Jazz team that lost by 20 and is without its starting center. The number is too generous.

401909850.blurb: Memphis beat Utah by 20 to open; Golden State lost by 22 at the Lakers. The Warriors are without Jimmy Butler (ACL) and Moses Moody (knee) long term and Kristaps Porzingis (illness, away from the team), with Brandin Podziemski questionable. Memphis has Cedric Coward doubtful and Isaiah Stewart questionable. Golden State favored by 3.5 at home despite all that.

pick.why: Golden State lost by 22 without Butler, Porzingis and Moody, and may be without Podziemski too. Memphis has its own questions but won by 20. Hard to see the Warriors as a 3.5-point favorite right now.

401909851.blurb: Both LA teams won their openers by 20 or more (Lakers 127-105 over Golden State, Clippers 121-96 over Sacramento), but the Clippers are badly shorthanded: Bradley Beal, Brandon Ingram, Max Strus, Jordan Miller and Yanic Konan Niederhauser are all out. The Lakers have Jake LaRavia questionable and Walker Kessler playing with a finger splint. That gap is the 9.5.

injuries.note: Leading scorer; heel.
Knee; the second unit loses its main scorer.

pick.why: The Clippers are missing Ingram, Beal and Strus, but they beat Sacramento by 25 on opening night with that same depleted group. Nine and a half is a lot to lay against a 1-0 team in a crosstown game.

401909852.blurb: Portland crushed Phoenix 124-83 in its opener; Sacramento lost 121-96 to the Clippers. The Kings are without Ben Simmons (Achilles) with Malik Monk probable. Portland is missing Shaedon Sharpe (meniscus). Road favorite by 7.5 after one game is a strong statement about Sacramento.

injuries.note: Leading scorer; meniscus surgery.
Achilles surgery; long-term.
Sixth man scorer; expected to play.

pick.why: Portland looked great against Phoenix, but it is without its 20-a-night scorer and is now a 7.5-point road favorite after one game. Sacramento was embarrassed by the Clippers and should play harder at home; the number is inflated.

401909853.blurb: Second night of a back-to-back for both: Miami hosts Detroit and Charlotte hosts Atlanta on Friday. Charlotte is already without Coby White, Grant Williams and Kon Knueppel; Miami's report is clean. Fatigue and Friday's results will shape the line once it posts.

injuries.note: Hamstring; status for Saturday to be confirmed.
Calf; status for Saturday to be confirmed.

pick.why: Early lean to Miami: both teams play Friday night, but Charlotte is down two starters. Pick firms up once the line posts.

401909854.blurb: Two 0-1 teams. Brooklyn lost 110-103 at home to Charlotte; Cleveland lost 114-106 in Philadelphia. The Cavaliers are without Nae'Qwan Tomlin (back, three to four weeks). Brooklyn has Tyler Bilodeau day-to-day with a shoulder. Line should post Friday night or Saturday morning.

injuries.note: Back stress reaction, three to four weeks.
Shoulder, day-to-day.

pick.why: Early lean to Cleveland at home after a close loss in Philadelphia; Brooklyn lost at home to a depleted Charlotte team. Pick firms up once the line posts.

401909855.blurb: Philadelphia is 2-0 after wins at New York and at home over Cleveland (114-106). Milwaukee plays a 4 PM game in Chicago on Friday, so this is a back-to-back for the Bucks. The Sixers are without Dominick Barlow (back) and have Dean Wade and Tacko Fall day-to-day; Milwaukee's report is clean.

injuries.note: Back, at least two weeks.
Ankle, day-to-day.
